spec.query:
from(bucket: "energy_meters")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "energy-meters")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "pf" or r["_field"] == "phase")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${deviceId}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "energy_meters")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "energy-meters")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "vRms" or r["_field"] == "vRmsFund")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${deviceId}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "voltajes")

from(bucket: "energy_meters")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "energy-meters")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "iRms" or r["_field"] == "iRmsFund")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${deviceId}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "voltajes")

from(bucket: "energy_meters")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "energy-meters")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "pActive" or r["_field"] == "pActiveF" or r["_field"] == "pActiveH")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${deviceId}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "voltajes")

from(bucket: "energy_meters")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "energy-meters")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "qReactive")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${deviceId}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "voltajes")

from(bucket: "energy_meters")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "energy-meters")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "sApparent")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${deviceId}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "voltajes")

from(bucket: "energy_meters")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "energy-meters")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "thdV" or r["_field"] == "thdI")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${deviceId}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "energy_meters")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "energy-meters")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /^dftV([0-9]|1[0-3])$/) 
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${deviceId}")
  |> last()
  |> duplicate(as: "_time", column: "_stop")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement"]) 
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

from(bucket: "energy_meters")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "energy-meters")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /^dftI([0-9]|1[0-3])$/) 
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${deviceId}")
  |> last()
  // truco: pisamos el _time real con una constante (el _stop del rango) para que todos tengan exactamente el mismo tiempo
  |> duplicate(as: "_time", column: "_stop")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement"]) 
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
